Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and slender long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: BIMBA is the ONE BLUE SPROTO in reference image 1. Preserve the tall elongated smooth cobalt-blue head and LONG broad BLUE NECK, red-orange triangular side/back spikes, large pale-yellow oval eyes with tiny dark RED pupils and small white highlights, fine black eyelid/brow lines, huge wide protruding RED smiling muzzle/lips with NO TEETH. No beard, hair, hat, tie, human face or separate oversized round nose. Preserve the RED garment and exceptionally BROAD YELLOW wraparound shawl-like collar that curves around both shoulders and meets toward the chest. This is a wide yellow clothing collar, NOT a cape, scarf, necklace or necktie. BIMBA has slender BLUE bare arms, long blue hands and graceful visible fingers, one hand often poised near the lower face in guard. Extend the cropped lower body conservatively: a simple opaque red tunic/top beneath the wide yellow collar, long blue torso/neck proportions retained, low-rooted slender blue legs and simple dark red shoes. Yellow collar and red clothing remain consistent in every frame. Composed confident bearing and gentle broad smile. Only one full-body BIMBA per cell. Image 1 is the original portrait. Image 2 is the approved complete-body BIMBA design: copy the EXACT tall blue head/long broad neck, pale yellow eyes with tiny red pupils, broad red smiling muzzle, red-orange side spikes, wide yellow collar and red top, low blue legs, red shoes and long fingered blue hands. Keep the distinctive elongated neck rather than a round stock head.

Exactly EIGHT separate full-body drawings in a regular 4-column by 2-row grid. A continuous guarded fighting footwork loop, NOT a run. Upper body stays calm, head/torso size constant, hips stay at the same height and same x center. Both fists remain raised. Feet are clearly different on adjacent frames: 0 near foot forward grounded/far foot back grounded; 1 transfer weight to near sole, far heel lifts; 2 far knee passes under low pelvis with far foot lifted; 3 far foot reaches forward while near sole still supports; 4 far foot forward grounded/near foot back grounded; 5 transfer weight to far sole, near heel lifts; 6 near knee passes under low pelvis with near foot lifted; 7 near foot reaches forward ready to plant. No feet crossing through one another, no sliding torso, no detached hips. Each frame has at least one clearly grounded foot. Last frame loops to first. Same complete body and clothing as the combat reference.
 Preserve the distinctive TALL head/neck silhouette; do not shrink into a round-headed stock fighter. The wide yellow collar follows the shoulders, stays connected to the red top and never becomes extra arms. Blue wrists and fingered hands have no boxing gloves or cuffs. All knees and legs attach low under the torso, never at the collar or neck. Strict exact count and generous pure magenta gutters around each complete figure.
